bullets.text: Deep learning powers features like language translation and image grouping.
It is a subset of machine learning, which is a subset of artificial intelligence.
AI mimics human behavior; ML achieves AI through data-trained algorithms.
Deep learning is inspired by the human brain's structure, called an artificial neural network.
Deep learning automatically picks features, unlike machine learning which requires human input.
This independence comes at the cost of needing a much higher volume of training data.
Neural networks identify handwritten digits, represented as 28x28 pixel images (784 pixels).
Neurons are the core information processing entities in a neural network.
The network consists of an input layer, hidden layers, and an output layer.
Information transfers via weighted channels; each neuron has a unique bias.
Bias is added to the weighted sum of inputs, then fed to an activation function.
Activated neurons pass information to subsequent layers, leading to the identification of the input digit.
Weights and bias are continuously adjusted to train the network effectively.
Customer Support: Realistic conversational bots.
Medical Care: Detecting cancer cells and analyzing MRI images.
Self-driving Cars: Companies like Apple, Tesla, and Nissan are developing this technology.
Data Volume: Requires a massive amount of data for training neural networks.
Computational Power: Needs expensive Graphical Processing Units (GPUs) with thousands of cores.
Training Time: Deep neural networks can take hours or even months to train, depending on data and layers.

sections.heading: Deep Learning Frameworks and Future Outlook

bullets.text: Popular deep learning frameworks include TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and Caffe.
Deep learning and AI are still in early stages with vast future potential.
Example: Horex Technology uses deep learning for a device describing the world to the blind.
Replicating the human mind may soon move beyond science fiction.
